Create a 2D dam-break simulation case in OpenFOAM using the interFoam solver with a sharp VOF free surface.
Set application to interFoam in system/controlDict.
Define the domain as 1 m wide (x), 1 m tall (y), and 0.01 m thick (z), giving a 2D slice extruded one cell in z.
Generate a uniform structured blockMesh of 100 cells in x, 100 cells in y, and 1 cell in z, yielding a cell size of 0.01 m by 0.01 m by 0.01 m.
Assign boundary patches as follows: bottom (y=0) is wall with no-slip, left (x=0) is wall with no-slip, right (x=1) is wall with no-slip, top (y=1) is a simple patch, and the two z-boundaries (z=0 and z=0.01) are named frontAndBack with type empty.
Initialize the fields using system/setFieldsDict so that alpha.water is set to 1 inside the box region defined by x from 0 to 0.5, y from 0 to 1, z from 0 to 0.01, and alpha.water is 0 everywhere else. This places the initial water column flush against the left wall occupying the left half of the domain full height, with air filling the right half.
In controlDict set startTime to 0, stopAt to endTime, endTime to 0.1, deltaT to 0.001, writeControl to timeStep, writeInterval to 10, purgeWrite to 0, writeFormat to ascii, and writePrecision to 6. This produces approximately 10 output snapshots over the 0.1 s run.
Set gravity in constant/g to (0 -9.81 0).
Set standard water-air transport properties in constant/transportProperties: water density 1000 kg/m3, air density 1.225 kg/m3, water kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s, air kinematic viscosity 1.5e-5 m2/s, and surface tension sigma 0.072 N/m.
Use default interFoam fvSchemes (Gauss linear for div schemes, corrected Gauss linear for laplacian, Euler or backward for time scheme) and default fvSolution (PISO algorithm with appropriate under-relaxation and linear solver settings for alpha, p_rgh, and U).
Ensure the case directory follows standard OpenFOAM layout with system/ (blockMeshDict, controlDict, fvSchemes, fvSolution, setFieldsDict, decompDict optional) and constant/ (transportProperties, g, polyMesh with blockMeshDict).
The case must be runnable with the sequence: blockMesh, setFields, interFoam.
